thesis: The debate centers on two competing philosophies regarding AI acceleration: Effective Accelerationism (EAC), which argues that rapid technological progress is an inevitable physical force that must be adopted to avoid missing a better future, and Defensive Accelerationism (Deac), which warns that speed without safeguards risks concentrating power in fewer hands. The discussion frames this tension as a modern iteration of historical cycles where rapid technological change, such as the transition from horses to tanks, has consistently led to destructive outcomes that subsequent generations attempt to address through either acceptance or restraint.
